_meta.source: Self-aggregated from the live AoE2 match backend (aoe-api.worldsedgelink.com)
_meta.method: Sampled the top 2000 ranked 1v1 Random Map players, pulled recent completed matches (getRecentMatchHistory), filtered matchtype_id=6 with exactly 2 players finishing in the last 2 week(s), deduped by match id, and tallied per-civ / per-map-type / civ-vs-civ / civ-vs-civ-per-map-type.
_meta.note: Live official backend data — current and covers all played civs including the newest (Mapuche/Muisca/Tupi). Bias: top-of-ladder sample reflects high-level play; per-map-type civ-vs-civ cells with few games are noisy (filter by `games`).
